title: Wrapped
description: A year of listening told as a story: six bold cards with segmented progress, huge type, numbers that roll in on a slot, the top song, the top five and the album of the year with real covers. Tap right to go on and each card wipes open from your finger; tap left to go back, hold to pause.
intent: A finished story player: auto-advancing segments, hold to pause, tap zones, and a circular wipe from the tap point carrying each card's colour, with slot-machine numerals as the flourish.
